guide.title: Zhaoyang Village

source.author: A_Backdated_Future

save_points: Center of town, near the well
objectives: Explore **Zhaoyang Village** and collect hidden items
Gather the **Metal Bowl** and **Torch** to use with **Anti-Cat Powder**
Defeat the **Felinus** sub-boss in the pit house
Prepare the party to **Level 6** and defeat **Yamaraja: Earth**
Acquire the **Shell Bracelet** and **Snake Card** before departing to **Fengtian**

initial_setup.note: **Zhuzhen** comes equipped with an **Oak Staff** and a **Cotton Shirt** by default.

strategy.text: Note that **Yamaraja: Earth** is actually a **WATER class**.
As I mentioned above, he's pretty dangerous! If you can't beat him, level up in town for a while before trying again. I recommend at least **Level 6** for everyone.

items.text: **Threats**

His **Flash Flood** will hit an ally for pretty good damage, while his **Large Whirlpool** will hit your entire party for major damage, as well as possibly halving your **Hit Area** on your **Ring**, so be sure to heal after it hits.
His physical attacks are also nothing to sneeze at, as they can take away large chunks of HP at a time.
**Positioning**
Make sure that **Alice** and **Zhuzhen** are in the back row, and when in doubt, just heal.
**Yuri**
Have **Yuri** fuse into the **Raging Tiger** and use his **Flying Stones** attack, followed by normal attacks.
If needed, have **Yuri** supplement healing since **Zhuzhen**'s fire magic probably hits for more than **Yuri** does, and make sure to keep **Alice** from becoming **Berserk**.
**Alice**
Have **Alice** stay on healing duty the entire time, and have **Zhuzhen** cast **Ogre Flamedance** continuously.

boss.name: Yamaraja: Earth
boss.strategy:
Note that **Yamaraja: Earth** is actually a **WATER class**. As I mentioned above, he's pretty dangerous! If you can't beat him, level up in town for a while before trying again. I recommend at least **Level 6** for everyone.
His **Flash Flood** will hit an ally for pretty good damage, while his **Large Whirlpool** will hit your entire party for major damage, as well as possibly halving your **Hit Area** on your **Judgment Ring**, so be sure to heal after it hits. His physical attacks are also nothing to sneeze at, as they can take away large chunks of HP at a time. Make sure that **Alice** and **Zhuzhen** are in the back row, and when in doubt, just heal.
Have **Yuri** fuse into the **Raging Tiger** and use his **Flying Stones** attack, followed by normal attacks. Have **Alice** stay on healing duty the entire time, and have **Zhuzhen** cast **Ogre Flamedance** continuously. If needed, have Yuri supplement healing since Zhuzhen's fire magic probably hits for more than Yuri does, and make sure to keep Alice from becoming **Berserk**.

steps.description:
1. When you regain control, head back south to the **first area** of town, where you'll find an **Angel's Feather**, roughly around the center of the area, just to the lower-right of a pile of sticks.
2. Go back up to the previous screen, then follow along the right side until you see the '?' icon near another pile of sticks.
3. There is a **Bronze Arrowhead** to be found here.
4. Continue north to the next area.

1. Use the **Save Point** here to save and clear **Malice** in the **Graveyard** if needed, then check around the right side of the well here by a board on the ground to find a **Tent**.
2. Go all the way to the right, then all the way up; the corner up here by the **Lost Peddler**/**Wandering Merchant** has a **Talisman of Luck** lying on the ground.

1. Feel free to shop with the **Wandering Merchant**; I using your money for just healing items for now, such as some **Thera**, **Mana**, and **Pure Leaves**, if you have the extra money.
2. **Pure Leaves** will really come in handy in the first part of the game, where characters like **Alice** have hardly any SP and can't last in a long battle without going **Berserk**.
3. We'll be visiting another town soon, so we'll be able to go shopping there with some more money.
4. If you have some extra now, or if the money's just burning a hole in your pocket, then buy some **Leather Belts** and **Bandannas** so you have 3 each for your active party, and if you do, make sure to equip both **Yuri** and **Alice** with both of them before continuing on.

1. When you're ready, head all the way north to the next area.
2. Watch the events here, then enter the house the children invite you to and continue watching the events unfold.
3. After some rest, you'll have to take on two **Hellcats**.

boss.name: Hellcat, Hellcat
boss.strategy: They're not too bad; just have **Yuri** fuse into the **Raging Tiger** and wail on them with regular attacks while **Alice** keeps both of you healed with either **Cure** or **Thera Leaves**.

steps.description: After the battle, head back into the house and examine the dresser at the very top of the screen to find a **Phoenix Tail**.

1. Go back outside, then make your way north back to the **shrine**.
2. After a scene with the **Cat Lady**, head back to the previous area and make your way to the left side of the well, where you'll encounter her again.
3. Head south to the **second area**, where you'll run into her yet again.
4. Continue south back to the **first area**.

1. Here, you'll run into the **Quack Oracle**, who will introduce himself as the true ruler of the nine heaves, the absolute sage Master **Li Zhuzhen**, referred to as **Zhuzhen** from here on out.
2. You'll also meet Wanderer **Meiyuan** the acupuncturist, who's got a thing for **Yuri**, and would love to just stick his needles in him...
3. **Zhuzhen** will decide to help you out and will temporarily join your party!

notes.title: Zhuzhen Equipment & Meiyuan Acupuncture
notes.text:
- **Zhuzhen** comes equipped with an **Oak Staff** and a **Cotton Shirt** by default.
- As for **Meiyuan**, he can't fight, but his acupuncture allows you to increase the **Attack Power** of your weapon, the **Hit Area** on the **Judgment Ring**, or both.
- It costs a lot of money to do it at this point, so I don't recommend it. We'll be able to buy new weapons in the next town which will be stronger anyway.
- However, if you're having trouble hitting areas on the **Judgment Ring**, then by all means, try to increase the **Hit Area** if you can afford it.
- NOTE: If you want to see how much it would cost to power up your weapons, check out section A-1-08 for the cost for every weapon in the game.

steps.description:
1. Once you regain control, continue north to run into the **Cat Lady** once again.
2. Afterward, head back to the center of town to run into her again, then go back into the house you were lured into in the first place.
3. After a scene here, you'll learn that you need to find a **Metal Vessel** and a **Torch** to use with the **Anti-Cat Powder** you receive from **Zhuzhen** to continue.

1. Head back outside, then make your way south to the **second area**.
2. Here, follow along the western side of the area until the '?' icon pops up, allowing you to attempt a **Normal Ring**, just like in battle, to pick up the **Metal Bowl** we were looking for.

1. Continue south to the entrance, then examine the building just to the right of **Meiyuan** to find the **Torch** among a pile of sticks.
2. Now that we have both items that we needed, make your way back to the center of town and use the **Save Point**.

1. When you're ready, enter the **Cat Lady**'s house again and examine the pit in the center.
2. After an event, you'll have to fight her.

items.text: **Threats**
This lady isn't to be taken lightly. She can use the **Wind Fang** ability to hit everyone for **Wind** damage, and after a couple of turns, your whole party will be in need of healing, so beware.
**Yuri**
Since she's a **Wind class**, have **Yuri** fuse into the **Raging Tiger** and use the **Flying Stones** skill to do some decent damage to her, followed by regular attacks.
**Healing**
**Alice** should be keeping everyone healed, as should **Zhuzhen**.
If no one needs healing then, have **Zhuzhen** use his **Ogre Flamedance** spell, and **Alice** should attack normally.
As long as you stay healed and don't let **Alice** go **Berserk**, you should be fine.

steps.description: Once she's done, head back to the **Save Point** and use a **Tent** to recover your HP and MP.

notes.title: Level Recommendation & Boss Preparation
notes.text:
- This next boss is REALLY tough if you're at a low level.
- I strongly recommend fighting until everyone in your party is at least **Level 6** before continuing on; it should only take a few battles.
- If you get some extra money, those **Leather Belts** and **Bandannas** for everyone would probably be a good idea.

steps.description: When you're ready, head back north to the **shrine** and examine it. Do you dare violate the shrine?

choices.outcome: Initiates the boss battle against Yamaraja: Earth.

steps.description: Of course we do! Choose 2, and you'll have to take on **Yamaraja**.

steps.description:
1. After both the battle and following scene are over, examine the **shrine** once again to find a **Shell Bracelet**.
2. Head back south through town, talking to the **Lost Peddler** on the second screen for a **Snake Card**, which is a **Guild Card** that can be used for a discount in Shops.

notes.title: Remove Zhuzhen's Equipment
notes.text: After the battle, remove everything you can from **Zhuzhen**.

steps.description:
1. That's it for **Zhaoyang Village**, so go ahead and make your way to the gate, where **Zhuzhen** will leave your party.
2. Afterward, head out to the **World Map**.
3. Our next destination is **Fengtian**!
